summary.text: A 59-year-old woman with psoriatic arthritis for 20 years, type 2 diabetes for 1 year on metformin and biopsy-confirmed generalized pustular psoriasis (GPP), with recurrent annular pruritic skin lesions since 2019 temporarily relieved by topical mometasone and Fucidin, attended dermatology follow-up after a flare-up dose of spesolimab.

Baseline CBC, liver and renal function tests were normal, serology and tuberculosis screening (purified protein derivative, chest X-ray) were negative, CRP was elevated at 17 mg/L and DLQI was 21. She reported fatigue and malaise without fever, headache or anorexia; fissured tongue was seen, with no ocular or gastrointestinal involvement and normal nails.
Before spesolimab, on the 28th of November, she had sterile non-follicular pustules 2 to 3 mm in size coalescing into lakes of pus, with residual erythema and desquamation on the back and right arm.

She received spesolimab 900 mg IV as a flare-up dose. At day 10 she had marked improvement with GPPGA 0.33, and at day 31 clear skin with GPPGA 0 and complete clinical remission of the flare-up; she reported sustained skin clearance and no pruritus until June 2025 without maintenance therapy.

article_limitations: The date of the spesolimab dose is not stated; the 28th of November pre-treatment date has no year, and day 10 and day 31 are given relative to the dose.
The pre-treatment GPPGA score and the day 10 and day 31 symptom statements carry no time of their own in their sentences; their timing is carried by the timeline events.
Fig 3 to Fig 6 captions do not say which panel is pre-treatment, day 10 or day 31; no per-panel timepoint is assigned.
Trial and literature statements (Effisayil-1, Effisayil-2, Brigenti et al, Morita et al, Elewski et al) in the discussion are not facts about the index patient.
No hospitalization history is recorded as a fact beyond the source statement of no prior hospitalizations, which has no matching schema item.
The pre-treatment GPPGA mean (3.3) is inconsistent with its stated components (each 3); kept review_only.
